reason: A knowledge-management plugin that imports local documents, organizes them into folders, stores parsed content in SQLite, and provides agent-accessible and Web UI full-text search and management tools.

summaries.zh: 将本地文档导入可检索的知识库，支持分段、文件夹整理、全文搜索以及通过智能体工具和网页界面进行管理。
summaries.en: Imports local documents into a searchable knowledge base with chunking, folder organization, full-text search, and management through agent tools and a Web UI.

capabilities: Imports and parses local PDF, DOCX, Markdown, text, JSON, and YAML files
Stores document content and metadata in a local SQLite knowledge base
Provides full-text search with FTS5 and BM25 ranking
Allows users or agents to list, organize, rename, move, update, and delete knowledge-base entries and folders
Exposes local Web UI and API endpoints for knowledge-base management
